title: Bazaar kay manzar ko, aur apney khuley sar ko bhuli nahi mai
body:
Bazaar kay manzar ko, aur apney khuley sar ko bhuli nahi mai
Apney bandhey haathon ko, bimaar kay zeiwar ko
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Utt thi huvi aandhi ko, wehshat ko biyaabaan ko
Chuptey huvey suraj ko, taareeki ko maidaan ko
Chaltey huvey khanjar ko, Naizey pey terey sar ko,
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek chaand tha badhli mai, chuptha tha nikal ta tha
Pardah darey khaima ka, utt tha kabhi girta tha
Woh khaimaa e laila sey, Haaye rukhsatey Akbar ko,
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad aata hai dulhan ko, gatt kis tarha aaye thay
Ek gattri shahey waala, jab kaandhon pey laaye thay
Is laash ki gattri ko, Us khoon bhari chaadar ko,
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Fizza ko mera bhaayi, maa kehkay bulaata tha,
Dum uska meray bhaayi, yeh naam pey jaata tha
Ruthbey mai jo maa bankar, aayi thi maadar ko,
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Lehraatey huvey naiza, aur shimr ka woh barddna,
Aa aa kay meray peechey, har bibi ka woh chuppna
Sholoun mai girey gharko, Chinnti huvi chaader ko,
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yaad aata hai ek maa ka, woh khaak mei dhas jaana
Aur aag ke sholoun mei, woh maa ka julas jaana
Jalte huvey jhooley sey, Lipti huvi maadar ko,
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Masoom Sakina ko, bardtey huvey naizoun ko
Sistey huvey gaalon ko, bey rahem tamaachon ko
Sistey huvey kaanon ko, Khichtey huvey gauhar ko,
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jis raat mae tanhaa thi, us raat kay dhalney ko
Tootey huvey naizey ko, us raat kay pehrey ko
Bachchon kay sisakney ko, Aur raaq kay bistar ko,
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Un shaam ki galiyon ko, jinsey khuley sar guzrey
Kis dar sey guzar ney mai, yeh tolaa pahen guzrey
Darbar kay us dar ko, Aur shaamiyon kay shar ko,
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai aaj bhi woh giryaa, Hai aaj bhi wo zaari
Hai aaj bhi patthar kay, Seenay sey lahu jaari
Rothay huvey patthar ko, Patthar pey rakhey sarko,
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
<<DIVIDER>>
Aati hai Navaid ab bhi, aawaaz yeh Zainab ki
Hai mujhko qasam saddiyon, sey sukhey huvey labb ki
Pyaasey ali asghar ko, Sukhey huvey saagher ko,
<<MINI>>
bhuli nahi mai
